blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_FIRST: saili le uluai iloaina o le tusitusiga
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_LAST: saili le iloaina mulimuli o le tusitusiga
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Toe faafoi le faasino o le iloaina muamua/mulimuli o le tusitusiga muamua i le tusitusiga lona lua. Toe faafoi %1 pe a le maua le tusitusiga.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Toe faafoi moni pe a gaogao le tusitusiga ua tuuina.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Fausia se vaega o tusitusiga e ala i le tuufaatasia o soo se aofai o mea.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Toe faafoi le aofai o mataitusi (aofia ai avanoa) i le tusitusiga ua tuuina.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Lolomi le tusitusiga, numera po o se isi tau ua faamaoti.
blockly-TEXT_PROMPT_TOOLTIP_NUMBER: Fesili i le tagata faaaoga mo se numera.
blockly-TEXT_PROMPT_TOOLTIP_TEXT: Fesili i le tagata faaaoga mo nisi tusitusiga.
blockly-TEXT_PROMPT_TYPE_NUMBER: fesili mo se numera ma se savali
blockly-TEXT_PROMPT_TYPE_TEXT: fesili mo se tusitusiga ma se savali
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_MESSAGE0: sui %1 i le %2 i totonu o %3
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Sui mea uma e aliali mai ai se tusitusiga i totonu o se isi tusitusiga.
blockly-TEXT_REVERSE_TOOLTIP: Fesuiai le faasologa o mataitusi i le tusitusiga.
blockly-TEXT_TEXT_TOOLTIP: Se mataitusi, upu, po o se laina o tusitusiga.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: tipi avanoa mai itu e lua o
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_LEFT: tipi avanoa mai le itu agavale o
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: tipi avanoa mai le itu taumatau o
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Toe faafoi se kopi o le tusitusiga ua aveese avanoa mai se tasi pe pito uma e lua.
blockly-VARIABLES_GET_TOOLTIP: Toe faafoi le tau o lenei fesuisuiai.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Seti lenei fesuisuiai ia tutusa ma le mea e tuu.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS: Ua iai se fesuisuiai e igoa '%1'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Ua iai se fesuisuiai e igoa '%1' mo se isi ituaiga: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Ua iai se fesuisuiai e igoa '%1' o se parameter i le galuega '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_MANY: %1 faaputuga o poloka%2 i le nofoaga faigaluega.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Tasi le faaputuga o poloka%2 i le nofoaga faigaluega.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ZERO: Leai ni poloka%2 i le nofoaga faigaluega.
blockly-WORKSPACE_LABEL_MUTATOR_WORKSPAC: Nofoaga faigaluega o le faatonu poloka
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Saili le nofoaga faigaluega. Oomi Enter mo le mea fetaui e sosoo ai, Shift+Enter mo le mea fetaui talu ai. Oomi Escape e tapuni ai le sailiga ma taulai i le mea fetaui o iai nei.
r-blocks-help: Faafesootai se mea faaosofia e tasi i se gaioiga e tasi. Toso poloka mai le pusa meafaigaluega. Faaaoga le faatonu pepa fesili mo filifiliga maualuluga.
r-blocks-discard: Lafoai suiga o poloka e lei teuina?
r-blocks-unavailable: E le maua faamatalaga o le tulafono. Faaaoga le faatonu pepa fesili e toe iloilo ai lenei tulafono.
r-blocks-invalid: Faafesootai na o le tasi le mea faaosofia i le tasi gaioiga. Aveese poloka ua motusia po o poloka faaopoopo a o lei teuina.
r-blocks-conflict: Na suia lenei tulafono a o e teuteuina. Toe utaina le tulafono ua teuina a o lei teuina.
r-blocks-permission: E manaomia le faatagaga a le pule o le laupapa e teuteu ai tulafono.
r-blocks-reload: Toe utaina le tulafono ua teuina
board-view-product-backlog: Lisi o Galuega o le Oloa (Backlog)
scrum-policy-doneLists: Pepa i se lisi o le vaega Ua Maea
scrum-rollover-sprint: Sii galuega e lei maea i le
scrum-product-backlog: Lisi o Galuega o le Oloa (Backlog)
scrum-edit-sprint: Fausia pe teuteu se sprint ua fuafuaina
scrum-releases-select-help: E mafai ona i ai se pepa i ni faasalalauga se tele. Taofi Ctrl (Cmd i se Mac) e filifili ai ni mea e sili atu ma le tasi; faamama uma e aveese ai le pepa mai faasalalauga uma.
scrum-select-sprint: Filifili se sprint e vaai ai i lona lipoti.
scrum-backlog-help: Faasologa galuega i le tulaga i le backlog. Tofia pepa i se sprint ua fuafuaina pe o loo galue.
scrum-events: Mea e tutupu i le sprint
scrum-event-kind: Ituaiga o le mea e tupu
scrum-no-closed-sprints: E leai se ata faamaumau o se sprint ua tapunia e maua.
scrum-report-help: E teu e lipoti fuafuaga mai ata faamaumau o le sprint. O fuafuaga e le iloa e faitau eseese; e le o ni fuafuaga e zero. Faatusatusa le saoasaoa na o iunite fuafuaga ma tulafono e tutusa.
scrum-total: __count__ pepa; __estimate__ ua fuafuaina; __unknown__ e le iloa
scrum-confirm-close: Tapuni lenei sprint ma teu ona iuga? O pepa e lei maea o le a sii i le nofoaga filifilia.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Faalēaogā lenei sprint? O ona pepa e tumau pea i ai seia toe tofia.
scrum-list-category: Vaega o le faagasologa o galuega Scrum
scrum-partial-report: Lipoti vaega: e na o pepa o loo tofia nei ia te oe e aofia ai.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: E le mafai ona toe faafoi se faasinoga o le puna: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: O lenei sprint e aofia ai na o se vaega o le ata faamaumau muamua.
scrum-resume-close: Faaauau le tapunia o le sprint na faalavelaveina
scrum-rollover-progress: O loo sii i luma pepa o le sprint: __done__ mai le __total__
scrum-history-job-running: O loo faaleaogāina pe toe faia se suiga tele: __done__ mai le __total__ laina o le talafaasolopito
scrum-history-job-failed: Ua taofi le faaleaogāina po o le toe faia o se suiga tele. Toe oomi le faaleaogā po o le toe fai e faaauau ai:
scrum-daily-observations: Lautele i aso taitasi ma galuega o totoe (matauga)
scrum-daily-observations-help: O pa taitasi e faaali ai le matauga muamua na faamaumauina o se aso UTC, i le taimi o loo faaalia. O aso e misi e le faaalia. E le faamaumauina e nei matauga suiga uma pe faaali aofai i le faaiuga o le aso. O fuafuaga e le iloa e le o ni zero. Faaaoga le gaioiga Auina atu o lenei vaega mo matauga o aso taitasi; o le gaioiga Auina atu i le pa meafaigaluega e auina atu ai iuga o le sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: E na o matauga lata mai e 366 o loo faaalia.
scrum-daily-empty: E lei faamaumauina ni matauga o aso taitasi mo lenei sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Aofaʻiga o galuega ma galuega o totoe, suiga taʻitasi
scrum-scope-history-help: Toe fausia mai le talaʻaga o le laupapa talu ona amata le vaitaimi o galuega: tasi le laina mo suiga taʻitasi i pepa o le vaitaimi, fua faatatau po o galuega ua maeʻa.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: E lē toe faia e le talaʻaga le ata o le tulaga tonu o lenei vaitaimi o galuega: na faia nisi suiga e aunoa ma le faamauina i le talaʻaga, o lea e lē atoatoa ai nei tau.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Na o suiga muamua na mafai ona faitau; e lē atoatoa le toe fausia.
scrum-scope-history-empty: E leai ni suiga talu ona amata le vaitaimi o galuega.
scrum-scope-cause-start: Ua amata le vaitaimi o galuega
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: Ua suia le auai i le vaitaimi o galuega
scrum-scope-cause-dates: Ua suia le tulaga o le maeʻa
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Ua teuina le pepa i le faamaumauga po o ua toe faafoʻi
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Matauga muamua na faamaumauina o aso UTC taitasi; o aso e misi e le faaalia. E le faamaumauina e matauga suiga uma po o aofai i le faaiuga o le aso. O fuafuaga e le iloa e le o ni zero.
scrum-import-pending: E lei maea le faaulufale Scrum. E le maua suiga Scrum ma le auina atu o lipoti.
scrum-import-discard: Faʻaleaogā le aumaia i totonu e leʻi maeʻa
scrum-import-recovery-hint: O se aumaia i totonu na motusia ona o le toe amata e mafai ona faʻauma i inei pe a uma ona taofi. Afai e leʻi teuina atoa lona fuafuaga, e na o le faʻaleaogāina e mafai; e lē suia ai se mea i le laupapa.
scrum-import-into-board: Faaulufale le fuafuaga Scrum i lenei laupapa
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Filifili se auina atu o le laupapa WeKan po o se faila feaveaii Scrum. O sprint ma faasalalauga o loo i ai i lenei laupapa e faafesootai, e le faaluaina lava. E faafetaui pepa i le ID, po o le numera ma le ulutala o le pepa; o pepa e le fetaui e lisiina ma tuu e aunoa ma se suiga. Muai vaai muamua e iloa ai mea o le a suia.
scrum-import-invalid-file: E le o se JSON aoga lenei faila.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprint: __created__ fou, __matched__ ua i ai i lenei laupapa, __skipped__ e le faaulufale
scrum-import-preview-releases: Faasalalauga: __created__ fou, __matched__ ua i ai i lenei laupapa, __skipped__ e le faaulufale
scrum-import-preview-cards: Pepa: __updated__ e faafou, __unchanged__ e le suia, __unmatched__ e le fetaui
scrum-import-preview-nothing: E leai se mea e sui: ua i ai lava lenei fuafuaga i lenei laupapa.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Ua faaulufale le fuafuaga Scrum ma faamaumau i le Talafaasolopito.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: E le maua se pepa i lenei laupapa: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: O se pepa e fetaui ma pepa e sili atu ma le tasi i lenei laupapa: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: O se pepa o se isi laupapa ma ua tuu e aunoa ma se suiga: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: O se sprint po o se faasalalauga e fetaui ma mea e sili atu ma le tasi i lenei laupapa: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: E le mafai ona faaulufale se sprint, faasalalauga po o se mea na tupu: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: E lei siitia se pepa i se sprint ua uma: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Filifili se tau mo feteenaiga taitasi. E toe taumafai le Sync pe a uma filifiliga taitasi. E leai se mea e auina atu i le faiga o le puna.
sync-conflict-local: Tau o iai nei i WeKan
sync-conflict-use-source: Faaaoga le tau o le puna
sync-conflict-refresh: Toe faatino le Sync e iloilo ai tau o iai nei.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Ua iloiloina au pepa ua tofia. E leai ni feteenaiga o fanua o totoe. E lei faatinoina le Sync o le lisi atoa.
sync-conflict-keep-mapping: O lenei pepa o le a tumau pea ona faatasi
sync-conflict-detach: Teu le kopi faalua o se pepa i le lotoifale
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Aveese na o le faafesootaiga Sync o lenei kopi faalua. E tumau ona anotusi i WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Ua poloka le teuina ona o pepa laiti o loo galue
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Ua leai le mea o le puna, ae o pepa laiti o loo galue e taofia ai le teuina. Teu lenei pepa i le lotoifale e ala i le aveeseina o lona faafesootaiga Sync. E le suia pepa laiti.
sync-conflict-keep-card-local: Teu lenei pepa i le lotoifale
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Tuu le pepa muamua e aunoa ma se suiga ma fausia se pepa Sync fou i lenei lisi. E toe faaaoga e taumafaiga faaopoopo le suitulaga.
sync-preview-saved: Faavae i faatulagaga ua teuina. O le Sync nei e toe aumai ma siaki le puna.
sync-preview-unavailable: Teu se puna Sync a o lei talosaga mo se muai vaaiga.
sync-preview-blocked: Foia feteenaiga i lalo a o lei iloilo le fuafuaga o suiga.
sync-preview-baseline: Faavae o le faatusatusaga o le puna
sync-preview-truncated: O loo faaali ai mea muamua e 100.
sync-preview-scope: O numera e faasino i fanua o le puna ua faatulagaina. O isi faamatalaga atonu e le aofia e le parser o le puna.
sync-preview-excluded: Ua le aofia ona o le filifiliga o fanua ua teuina
sync-preview-parser-unsupported: Mea e le aofia na lipotia e le parser
sync-source-heading: Fanua o le puna e le kopiina saʻo
sync-source-scope: O ala e faavasega ai le aliali mai o fanua i mea uma o le puna. O mea faitino e le faafesootaiina e lipotia atoa; e le faaalia o latou tau.
sync-source-excluded: Ua le aofia ona o le filifiliga o fanua ua teuina
sync-source-converted: Ua liua i tusitusiga po o se isi faatusa
sync-source-fallback: Tau suitulaga e le faaaogaina e le parser
sync-source-excluded-item: Mea ua le aofia e le parser
sync-source-occurrences: Aliali mai o fanua po o mea ua lipotia
sync-source-truncated: Ua faatapulaaina le lipoti i ala e 100 ma igoa o fanua ua faapuupuuina.
sync-source-omitted: Isi aliali mai i fafo atu o ala ua faaalia
sync-report-button: Faatinoga lata mai o le Sync
sync-report-retention: Faatinoga lata mai e 20. E teu lipoti mo aso e 30.
sync-report-partial: O faatinoga na le manuia pe lei maea atonu na suia ai nisi pepa. E le faaauau pe toe faaleaoga e nei lipoti se faatinoga.
sync-report-unfinished: O loo faagasolo pe na faalavelaveina; e lei faamaumauina le iuga
sync-report-failed: Ua le manuia; atonu o iai ni suiga vaega
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Ua maea ma ni fanua ua le aofia pe ua liua
sync-report-unavailable: O lipoti o faatinoga e manaomia ai le aia e tusi ai i le lisi atoa ma se server o loo avanoa.
sync-report-empty: E leai ni faatinoga Sync ua faamaumauina.
sync-recovery-description: Lipoti Sync ua teuina mai aso e 30 talu ai. Saili i le ID o le laupapa po o le lisi. O se iuga e lei maea atonu o loo faagasolo pea pe na faalavelaveina. Faafou e toe siaki; e le mafai e nei lipoti ona faaauau pe toe faaleaoga suiga.
sync-recovery-unavailable: E le mafai ona faitau suesuega Sync. Siaki le ulufale a le pule ma le avanoa o le server.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Filifili se fanua numera e iai le ID o le fanua Jira ma le iunite o le fuafuaga, e pei ona fausia e se faaulufale Jira ua faafesootaiina. O suiga i le lotoifale e iloiloina o ni feteenaiga. O tau o le puna e misi e le amanaia; o se null manino e faamama ai le tau ua faafesootaiina.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Vaega mo le fua faatatau i lenei laupapa
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: E tusia le mamafa po o le fua faatatau o le taimi a GitLab i le vaega mo numera ua e filifilia. E iloilo suiga i le lotoifale o ni feteenaʻiga; o se mataupu e leai sona mamafa e tape ai le tau ua fesootaʻi i ai.
email-recovery-heading: Lisi faatalitali mo le auina atu o imeli
email-recovery-description: E tasi le laina mo tagata taʻitasi e mauaina. Suʻe i le ID o le tagata faaaogā. E lē faaalia mataupu o feʻau ma vaega o le imeli a le tagata e mauaina. O le taofi mo sina taimi e taofia feʻau o loo iai ma feʻau o le a oo mai; o le faaauau e toe taumafai loa e auina atu feʻau o loo faatalitali. O le faalēaogā e aveese feʻau na tuu i le lisi seʻia oo i le taimi o le talosaga. Afai o loo faagasolo le auina atu, toe taumafai i se taimi lata mai. E lē mafai ona toe aumai se feʻau ua amata ona auina atu, ma e ono toe auina atu se feʻau e lē mautinoa lona taunuu. E tumau faaletonu tumau ma feʻau ua oo i le tapulaa o taumafaiga mo le toe iloiloina. O le toe taumafai i feʻau na lē manuia e amata ai se taamilosaga fou o taumafaiga ma e tausisia le taofi mo sina taimi ua iai.
email-recovery-saving: O loo faafou le lisi o imeli…
email-recovery-attempts: Aofaʻi aupito maualuga o taumafaiga toe fai
email-recovery-oldest: Taimi muamua na tuu ai i le lisi
email-recovery-changed: Suiga mulimuli a le tagata e faagaoioia
email-recovery-pause: Taofi le auina atu mo sina taimi
email-recovery-pending: O loo faatalitali pe toe taumafai
email-recovery-empty: E leai ni feʻau o loo faatalitali ma e leai ni tagata ua taofi mo sina taimi le auina atu iā i latou.
email-recovery-unavailable: E lē mafai ona faitau le lisi o imeli. Siaki faatagaga a le pule ma pe o avanoa le seva.
email-recovery-busy: O loo faagasolo le auina atu po o se isi galuega o le lisi. Faafou ma toe taumafai i se taimi lata mai.
email-recovery-failed: E leʻi mafai ona faamaonia le galuega. Faafou le lisi ma toe taumafai i le gaoioiga lava lea pe a manaʻomia.
email-recovery-superseded: Ua suia lenei talosaga e se gaoioiga fou a le tagata e faagaoioia. O loo faaalia le tulaga o le lisi i le taimi nei.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Faalēaogā feʻau uma o loo faatalitali i le taimi nei mo lenei tagata e mauaina? O le a aveese o latou mataupu ma e lē mafai ona toe maua. E teu pea feʻau fou na faia ina ua uma lenei talosaga.
email-recovery-stopped: Feʻau ua taofia le auina atu
email-recovery-retry: Toe taumafai e auina atu feʻau na lē manuia
email-failure-smtp-authentication: E manaomia le gauai i le faamaoniga o meli
email-failure-smtp-configuration: E manaomia le gauai i le faatulagaga o meli
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: E le maua le tagata e mauaina pe ua tapuni le teugatupe
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: E le mafai ona faamaonia le tuuina atu; iloilo a o lei toe taumafai
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: E le mafai ona teu le lisiti o le tuuina atu
email-failure-delivery-failed: Ua le manuia le tuuina atu po o le sauniuniga
email-failure-retry-limit: Ua oo i le tapulaa o taumafaiga otometi
sync-remaining-time: Fuafuaga o le taimi o totoe (itula)
sync-time-estimate-hint: O fuafuaga o le taimi e faaaoga ai fanua numera o le taimi muamua/o totoe na fausia e le faaulufale Jira. E tatau ona tasi lava le fanua fetaui i lenei laupapa. O suiga i le lotoifale e iloiloina o ni feteenaiga; o tau o le puna e misi e le amanaia ma o se null manino e faamama ai le tau.
sync-planning-hint: E faatasia Sprint ma faasalalauga na o le taimi o loo ola ai le Scrum i lenei laupapa. O se sprint po o se faasalalauga e misi e fausia i lenei laupapa, ma aso e tuuina mai e le puna; o se mea o loo i ai e faafetaui muamua i lona ID o le puna, ona sosoo ai lea ma le igoa. O se suiga o le fuafuaga i le lotoifale e tumau seia suia e le puna le fuafuaga o lena issue, ma e le aveese lava e se Sync muamua se fuafuaga.
activity-recovery-heading: Faasilasilaga o gaoioiga o loo faatali
activity-recovery-description: O faasilasilaga e lei maea e toe taumafai otometi. Iloilo gaoioiga e misi pe ua suia a o lei toe taumafai. E le toe fausia lava e le toe taumafai se gaoioiga.
activity-recovery-empty: E leai ni faasilasilaga o gaoioiga o loo faatali.
activity-recovery-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina faasilasilaga o gaoioiga o loo faatali.
activity-recovery-retrying: O loo faafou le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga…
activity-recovery-status-pending: O loo faatali le tuuina atu
activity-recovery-status-preparing: O loo faatali mo se fuafuaga o tagata e mauaina
activity-recovery-status-processing: O loo ola le faasaoina o le tuuina atu
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Faamatalaga toe faaleleia e le aoga
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: E le fetaui le fuafuaga ma le gaoioiga o loo faatali
activity-recovery-busy: O loo taulimaina e se isi tagata faigaluega lenei faasilasilaga. Faafou ma toe taumafai.
activity-recovery-denied: Ua le toe faataga e le ulufale a le tagata e mauaina po o filifiliga o faasilasilaga le tuuina atu.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Ua misi pe ua suia le gaoioiga muamua. E leai se mea na toe fausia.
activity-recovery-failed: E le mafai ona faamaea le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga. Ua teu pea galuega o loo faatali.
activity-recovery-pause: Taofi le auina atu mo sina taimi
activity-recovery-paused: Ua taofi le taimi le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga o gaoioiga.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Ua suia lenei faasilasilaga talu ona utaina. Iloilo le tulaga ua faafou a o lei toe taumafai.
activity-recovery-control-failed: E le mafai ona faamaonia le faatulagaga o le tuuina atu. Faafou ma iloilo lona tulaga o iai nei.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: Ua faalēaogāina le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga o gaoioiga.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Faalēaogā tumau le tuuina atu o totoe mo lenei gaoioiga? E le mafai ona toe faaauau. O imeli ua uma ona faatulaga ma faasilasilaga ua uma ona tuuina atu e le toe aumaia.
rule-email-recovery-description: Iloilo taumafaiga ua faamauina e lafo ai imeli a tulafono. O taumafaiga e leʻi faamaonia atonu o loo lafo pea pe na motusia. Tatala se tasi i le "Toe iloilo" e toe lafo ai, faailoga ua lafo, pe faaleaogā.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Ua talia e le seva imeli
rule-email-recovery-invalid: E lē saʻo faamatalaga e uiga i le taumafaiga
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: Faailo o le poloaʻiga / valaauga / taumafaiga
rule-email-recovery-empty: E leai ni taumafaiga e lafo imeli a tulafono e fetaui ma lenei sailiga.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina taumafaiga imeli a tulafono. Faafou e toe taumafai.
rule-email-recovery-dropped: Ua faaleaogāina le lafoina e se pule
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: E lē toe lafoina lava e WeKan na o ia se imeli e le'i faamaonia. E toe lafo na o tagata e le'i faamaonia. Faailoga ua lafo pe afai e te iloa ua taunuu, pe faaleaogā le lafoina.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Atonu o loo faagasolo pea le lafoina muamua. E mafai ona e filifili pe a mavae le __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Toe lafo i tagata e le'i faamaonia
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Toe lafo lenei imeli i tagata e le'i faamaonia? Afai na talia e le seva meli a se tagata le imeli ae le'i logoina WeKan, o le a maua e lea tagata faalua.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Faailoga lenei imeli ua lafo i tagata uma? Fai lenei mea pe afai e te iloa ua taunuu.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Faaleaogā le lafoina o lenei imeli? O le a lē lafoina i tagata e le'i faamaonia.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Atonu o loo faagasolo pea le lafoina muamua. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Ua uma ona fo'ia lenei imeli.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Atonu o loo faagasolo pea se toe lafoina muamua. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Ua uma ona faamaonia tagata uma e mauaina. Nai lo le toe lafo, faailoga ua lafo.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: E le'i tali mai le seva meli. Atonu ua taunuu le imeli na toe lafo, pe le'i taunuu; o loo faaalia o loo faagasolo.
rule-email-resolution-busy: O loo fo'ia e se isi pule lenei imeli. Toe taumafai i se taimi puupuu.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Ua lē toe fetaui le imeli ua teuina ma lenei taumafaiga, o lea e lē mafai ona fo'ia iinei.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: E lē aogā le faamaumauga ua teuina o lenei taumafaiga, o lea e lē mafai ona fo'ia iinei.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Ua lē mafai ona fo'ia lenei imeli. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Imeli o tulafono o loo faatali mo le toe iloiloga
rule-email-legacy-description: Na saunia nei imeli o tulafono e se lomiga tuai o WeKan e le'i faamaumauina le puna o a latou mataupu, o lea e lē lafoina ai e WeKan na o ia. Siaki muamua pe o iai pea le faatagaga a le tusitala o le tulafono e maua ai le pepa, ona toe faafesoota'i lea o le imeli ina ia toe saunia mai le tulaga o le pepa i le taimi nei, pe lafoa'i.
rule-email-legacy-mail: Tagata e mauaina ma le ulutala
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Faamatalaga o le pepa mai se lomiga tuai
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Toe saunia lenei imeli mai le tulaga o le pepa i le taimi nei? Atonu e ese ana mataupu mai mea na saunia muamua.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lafoa'i lenei imeli? O le a lē lafoina lava.
rule-email-legacy-empty: E leai ni imeli o tulafono o loo faatali mo le toe iloiloga.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Ua lē mafai ona uta imeli o tulafono o loo faatali mo le toe iloiloga. Toe uta le itulau e toe taumafai ai.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Ua lē toe iai le faatagaga a le tusitala o le tulafono e maua ai lenei pepa, pe ua suia le tulafono, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Ua suia le gaoioiga na mafua ai lenei imeli, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ua lē toe maua le pepa na sau ai lenei imeli, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ua lē toe teuina le faatinoga o le tulafono na saunia ai lenei imeli, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Ua uma ona lafo lenei imeli, taumafai e lafo, pe lafoa'i.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Ua uma ona toe faafesoota'i lenei imeli.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ua lē mafai ona faauma lenei gaoioiga. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Galuega List Sync e le mafai ona toe faatino
stuck-sync-operation-description: O nei galuega List Sync taitasi ua teuina na taofi i le ogatotonu ma ua le toe mafai ona faamaeaina, ona o lona lisi na aveese, toe fausia pe toe faatulaga, po o le tagata faaaoga na amataina ua leiloa lona aia e tusi ai. A o faatali se tasi, e le mafai e lena lisi ona Sync. Lafoai e faataga ai le lisi e toe Sync: o suiga ua uma ona faaaoga e tumau, o suiga ua teuina o totoe e le tusia lava, ma o le Sync e sosoo ai e toe faatusatusa le lisi ma lona puna.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Na aveese pe toe fausia le lisi pe suia ona faatulagaga Sync
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Ua le toe iai i le tagata faaaoga na amataina le aia e tusi ai i le lisi atoa
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Na teuina e se lomiga muamua o WeKan e aunoa ma le mea na amataina ai
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Ua misi le faamaumauga o le na amataina
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: E le mafai ona siaki nei
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: E mafai ona toe faatino nei ma o le a uma na o ia, o lea e le mafai ai ona lafoai.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Lafoai lenei galuega List Sync ua teuina? O suiga ua uma ona faaaoga e tumau; o isi e le tusia lava. E mafai ona toe Sync le lisi.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: E leai ni galuega List Sync o loo faatali mo se iloiloga.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: E na o mea sili ona tuai e 50 o loo faaalia. Lafoai nisi ma faafou e vaai ai i nisi.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina galuega List Sync. Faafou e toe taumafai.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Ua le toe faatali lenei galuega.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: E lei iloa ua mau lenei galuega, o lea e le mafai ai ona lafoai.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: E mafai ona toe faatino nei lenei galuega ma o le a uma na o ia, o lea e lei lafoaiina ai.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: O loo Sync lenei lisi i le taimi nei. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ua lē mafai ona faauma lenei gaoioiga. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
interrupted-import-heading: Faaulufale o laupapa na taofi a o lei maea
interrupted-import-description: O nei faaulufale o laupapa taitasi na taofi i le ogatotonu - na toe amata le server, po o le faaulufale na le manuia - ma tuu ai se laupapa vaega. E le mafai ona faaauau se faaulufale, ona e le teuina lona faila puna. Teu le laupapa e pei ona i ai, pe lafoai ma toe faaulufale le faila. O le lafoai e aveese ai le laupapa na fausia e lenei faaulufale ma mea uma o i ai, e aofia ai soo se mea na faaopoopo i ai talu mai.
interrupted-import-created: Ua fausia e oo mai nei
interrupted-import-state-stopped: Na taofi a o lei maea, i le __stage__
interrupted-import-state-failed: Na le manuia ma le __error__, i le __stage__
interrupted-import-state-discarding: O loo lafoaiina; toe lafoai e faamaea ai
interrupted-import-scrum: O lona vaega Scrum e iai lona lava siaki (__state__, __next__ o __total__ laasaga). Afai e te teuina le laupapa, faamaea pe lafoai mai le toe faaleleia o le faaulufale Scrum a le laupapa.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ ala, __lists__ lisi, __cards__ pepa, __checklists__ lisi siaki, __comments__ faamatalaga, __attachments__ faapipii
interrupted-import-no-board: E leai se laupapa na fausia
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Teu lenei laupapa vaega e pei ona i ai? E leai se mea e aveese, ma ua le toe lisiina iinei le faaulufale.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Lafoai lenei faaulufale? O le laupapa na fausia ma mea uma o i ai e aveese tumau.
interrupted-import-empty: E leai ni faaulufale o laupapa na faalavelaveina o loo faatali mo se iloiloga.
interrupted-import-truncated: E na o mea sili ona tuai e 50 o loo faaalia. Teu pe lafoai nisi ma faafou e vaai ai i nisi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina faaulufale o laupapa na faalavelaveina. Faafou e toe taumafai.
interrupted-import-missing: Ua le toe faamaumauina lenei faaulufale.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Ua le toe faatali lenei faaulufale mo se faaiuga.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: O le laupapa ma lenei id e lei fausia e lenei faaulufale, o lea e lei paia ai.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: O loo tusia pe toe faaleleia pea lona vaega Scrum. Toe taumafai i ni nai minute.
interrupted-import-failed: Ua lē mafai ona faauma lenei gaoioiga. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
saml-login-not-started: E leʻi amata lenei saini i totonu i le SAML i lenei itulau o le suʻesuʻega. Faamolemole toe saini i totonu.
history-request-pending-undo: E leʻi faamaonia e le seva lau toe faaleaogāina mulimuli o se suiga.
history-request-pending-redo: E leʻi faamaonia e le seva lau toe faia mulimuli o se suiga.
history-request-hint: O le toe taumafai e toe lafo ai le talosaga lava e tasi, o lea e lē mafai ai ona faaleaogāina se suiga lona lua.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: O se toe faaleaoga, toe fai po o se toe faafoi o suiga Scrum na taofi i se feteenaiga. Ua poloka suiga Scrum i lenei laupapa seia foia.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ o __total__ suiga na tusia, __pending__ e lei tusia, ma __conflicted__ na suia e se isi talu mai.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: O le toe faafoi i tua e toe tuu ai faamaumauga uma ua suia e pei ona sa i ai muamua; e ofo mai na o le taimi e leai se isi na suia na faamaumauga talu mai. O le teuina o le laupapa e pei ona i ai e aveese ai le galuega na taofi ma e le suia ai ni faamaumauga. Soo se auala, e faamaumauina i le Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Teu le laupapa e pei ona i ai
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Teu faamaumauga uma e pei ona i ai nei, e aofia ai suiga ua uma ona tusia e le galuega na taofi?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: E mafai e se pule o le laupapa ona toe faafoi i tua pe teu le laupapa e pei ona i ai.
header-login: Ulufale e ala i ulutala HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Aveese le tau o loo teuina i le laulau a le pule
login-setting-after-restart: E amata ona aogā pe a toe amata le WeKan
login-setting-env-only: E na o le siosiomaga o le server e setiina nei mea. O loo faaalia iinei e faitau na o ia.
email-to-card-description: O se imeli e auina atu i le tuatusi o lau laupapa e avea ma pepa i lena laupapa.
email-to-card-webhook: URL o le webhook o loʻo sau mai le kamupani imeli (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark poʻo se MIME relay mata)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Ua sefe - tuu gaogao e taofi ai
email-to-card-clear-secret: Aveese le mealilo o le webhook ua sefe
email-to-card-imap-after: A uma ona faitau se imeli
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Laupapa e alu i ai imeli i lenei grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Leai - na o imeli e iai le faailoga o le laupapa i le mataupu
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Tuu lenei mea i le mataupu e oo atu ai i lenei laupapa o oe lava:
email-to-card-board-enabled: E maua imeli e lenei laupapa
email-to-card-parts: Vaega o le imeli e faaaoga
email-to-card-part-description: Tino o le imeli e fai ma faamatalaga o le pepa
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Aua le faaaofia feʻau tuai ua siiina
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Laina o le na auina mai i le pito i luga o faamatalaga
email-to-card-your-address: Lau tuatusi imeli mo lenei laupapa
email-to-card-address-private: Ia natia: soo se tasi e iai e mafai ona faaopoopo pepa e pei o oe.
email-to-card-new-address: Tuatusi fou (o le tuai o le a le toe galue)
email-to-card-member-enabled: O loʻo galue oʻu tuatusi o laupapa
email-to-card-off-admin-off: E leʻi faatulagaina le mauaina o imeli i le Laulau a le pule.
email-to-card-off-board-off: E leʻi faaolaina e se pule o le laupapa le imeli mo lenei laupapa.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Ua e tapeina au tuatusi o laupapa i Faatulagaga o Sui.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: E leʻi iai se tuatusi imeli o le grain. Toe utaina le itulau.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: E te manaʻomia le avanoa e tusi ai i lenei laupapa.
inbound-domain-invalid: E le o se igoa domeni aoga lena.
inbound-domain-required: Tuuina mai le domeni o tuatusi o laupapa.
inbound-account-invalid: E manaʻomia e se pusa meli IMAP se igoa server aoga.
feature-views-email-desc: O le laupapa o se pusameli: o le lisi imeli o le Pusa o mai, o lisi o faila, o igoa faailoga o igoa faailoga, ma tusi ma tali e sui imeli mai le tuatusi o le laupapa.
email-view-not-receiving: E le o maua e lenei laupapa ni imeli. Ki i le Faatulagaga o faasilasilaga a le laupapa → Imeli i le pepa.
email-view-invalid-address: O se tasi o tuatusi e le o se tuatusi imeli aoga.
email-view-too-many-recipients: E le sili atu i le 20 e mauaina i se feʻau.
email-view-too-many: Ua tele naua imeli ua auina atu i le itula talu ai. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
email-view-no-list: E manaʻomia e le laupapa se lisi mo le imeli.
email-view-send-failed: E le mafai ona auina atu le imeli.
feature-views-chat-desc: O le laupapa o se avanoa talanoaga: avanoa faigaluega, laupapa, ala, lisi ma pepa o se laau o alalaupapa, o le pepa i le ogatotonu ma ana faamatalaga o feʻau talanoaga.
chat-view-message-cards: Faʻaali na o pepa e iai feʻau
chat-view-resize: Toso e sui ai le lapoʻa
chat-view-pick-card: Filifili se pepa mai alalaupapa e vaai ai iinei.
chat-view-no-messages: E leai ni feʻau. Tusi le muamua.
board-view-throughput-run: Ata o gaosiga i le taimi
board-view-due-date-performance: Faatinoga o aso e tatau ai
feature-views-column-sets-desc: O pepa lava ia i ni seti o koluma e tele ua faaigoaina - e tusa ma le maeaina, faamuamua, maata po o se isi lava mea - e siitia i le va o koluma e ala i le toso.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → E fautua mai e Tulafono ni tulafono mai mea e faia pea e tagata i lima.
feature-board-summary-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → E faaali mai e le Aotelega mea na faia e tagata taitoatasi i le laupapa i le aso po o le vaiaso mulimuli, ma mea ua tuai.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → Talu mai lau asiasiga mulimuli e faaali mai mea na suia e isi i le laupapa.
feature-search-phrases-desc: E malamalama le suʻesuʻega lautele i fuaitau faigofie e pei o "oʻu kata ua tuai".
column-sets-empty: E leai ni seti koluma. E mafai e se pule o le laupapa ona faia se tasi: tuu se igoa, ona faaopoopo lea o ona koluma.
feature-views-version-control: Vaaiga o le puleaina o lomiga
feature-views-version-control-desc: O le laupapa e pei o se su'esu'ega o fa'afitauli a GitHub po'o Gitea: pepa o fa'afitauli, igoa faailoga ma fa'ailoga taua, faamatalaga o le talanoaga, faapipiiga o faila, ma le talafaasolopito o le laupapa ma le toe faaleaogaina.
vcs-no-due-date: Leai se aso e tatau ai
vcs-no-issues: Leai ni fa'afitauli e fetaui ma lenei sailiga.
vcs-no-milestones: E leai ni fa'ailoga taua i le taimi nei. O se igoa faailoga ma se aso e tatau ai o se fa'ailoga taua.
vcs-no-labels: E leai ni igoa faailoga i le taimi nei.
vcs-no-files: E leai ni faila i le taimi nei.
vcs-no-description: E leai se faamatalaga na tuuina mai.
vcs-issue-title-required: E mana'omia e se fa'afitauli se ulutala.
vcs-no-list: E leai se lisi po'o se ala o lenei laupapa mo le fa'afitauli.
card-qr-code-desc: Su'esu'e e tatala ai lenei pepa i se telefoni po'o se tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Ua umi tele le so'otaga o lenei pepa mo se fa'ailoga QR.
vcs-no-wiki: E leai se wiki. O le aumaia o se faalapotopotoga GitHub e aumai ai le wiki o se fale teu i inei.
github-org-import: Aumai i totonu se faalapotopotoga GitHub atoa
github-org-import-desc: O fale teu uma o se faalapotopotoga po o se tagata faaaoga e avea ma ana laupapa, tatala i le Board View / Version Control: o ona fa'afitauli ma a latou faamatalaga, igoa faailoga ma faila, o ona faasalalauga, o ona galuega GitHub Actions o ni Tulafono, ma lona wiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: E manaomia mo fale teu patino ma se tapulaa API maualuga. E faaaoga na o le taimi o loo faagasolo ai le aumaia ma e le teuina lava.
github-org-import-issues: Fa'afitauli, ma faamatalaga, igoa faailoga ma faila
github-org-import-release-files: Faila o faasalalauga (e mafai ona tetele)
github-org-import-actions: Galuega GitHub Actions o ni Tulafono
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Tusi le igoa o se faalapotopotoga po o se tagata faaaoga, po o lona tuatusi GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: E leai ni fale teu e aumai.
github-org-import-running: O loo faagasolo se aumaia o se faalapotopotoga.
optional-apis-desc: O REST API e foliga i API a isi tracker, ina ia mafai ai e a latou polokalama ma tusitusiga (scripts) ona faaaogā lenei WeKan e fai ma o latou backend: o mea latou te teuina e teu i WeKan, i laupapa o WeKan. E tapuni taitasi seʻia siaki iinei. E leai se tasi e iai sana aia tatau: e saini mai se client i se API token a WeKan ma e mafai ona vaai ma suia na o mea e mafai e lea tagata ona vaai ma suia i WeKan. E manaʻomia e i latou uma ona ki le WeKan REST API (WITH_API=true). O le tuatusi i lalo o taitasi o le mea lea e faaaogā e se client e fai ma ana server.
optional-api-trello-desc: O polokalama ma tusitusiga na tusia mo le REST API a Trello (mo se faataitaiga Trellinator) e galulue ma WeKan: laupapa, lisi, pepa, igoa faailoga, sui, faamatalaga ma lisi siaki. O le token a Trello o se API token a WeKan. O le tapeina o se pepa e sii ai i le teuina i WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: O client o le REST API v2 a Jira e galulue ma WeKan: o se poloketi o se laupapa (o lona ki o le ki o le laupapa), o se faafitauli o se pepa (DEV-7), o se tulaga o se lisi, ma o se suiga e siitia ai le pepa. E talia e le suʻesuʻega le JQL faigofie: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ma ORDER BY. Saini mai i se API token a WeKan e fai ma upu faalilo. O le tapeina o se faafitauli e sii ai i le teuina.
optional-api-github-desc: O client o le REST API a GitHub mo faafitauli e galulue ma WeKan: o se repository o se laupapa, o se faafitauli o se pepa, faatasi ai ma igoa faailoga, faʻailoga taua (igoa faailoga e iai le aso e tatau ai), faamatalaga, ma tatala pe tapuni e pei o Vaaiga o le Laupapa / Puleaina o lomiga. O le token o se API token a WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: O client o le REST API a Gitea ma Forgejo mo faafitauli e galulue ma WeKan, e tutusa ma le API e fetaui ma GitHub: o se repository o se laupapa ma o se faafitauli o se pepa. O le token o se API token a WeKan.
bots-none: E leai ni robots. O le robot o se tagata faʻatino i lau lava server - o se sui AI, o se galuega CI, o se tusitusiga - e tuʻuina atu i ai e lenei laupapa pepa.
bots-no-runs: E leai se robot o loʻo galue nei.
bots-summary: %s o loʻo faia · %s o loʻo faatali mo oe
r-dispatch-bot: Tuʻu le pepa i le robot
bot-not-found: E le o i luga o lenei laupapa lena robot.
bot-option-not-found: E le o se tali lena na ofoina mai e le robot.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: E le mafai e Webhooks e Auina Atu ona oo atu i tuatusi i luga o le fesoʻotaʻiga a WeKan lava ia, ina ia le mafai e se tasi ona faasino le webhook a se laupapa i se auaunaga i totonu. Lisi iinei 'host' i luga o lena fesoʻotaʻiga e mafai ona oo atu i ai webhooks - se Node-RED, se 'server' talanoa - tasi i le laina, o se igoa po o se tuatusi, faatasi ma se 'port' e faataga ai na o lena 'port'. Avanoa: leai se mea. Na o Pule o le saite e mafai ona suia lenei lisi.
account-webhook: Webhook mo le ulufale ma le resitala
account-webhook-desc: O le tuatusi e tasi e logo i ai WeKan pe a ulufale se tasi pe faia se akaunia fou. E leai se mea e auina atu seia faailoga se mea e tupu i lalo. E aveina le mea na tupu, le igoa o le tagata faaaoga ma le taimi; faailoga isi vaega pe a manaomia e le tagata e mauaina.
account-webhook-on-register: Pe a faia se akaunia fou
account-webhook-field-ip: Tuatusi IP na sau ai le ulufale
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: E le o se host, e le'i teuina:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Faalēaogā uma faasilasilaga o loo faatali mo gaoioiga e sili atu ona tuai nai lo le fia aso?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Ua faalēaogāina %s, ua tuuina atu %s, %s tuai o loo faatali pea.
vcs-synced-from: Ua fa'atasi mai %s: tatala ma tapuni iina.
vcs-synced-issue: O lenei fa'afitauli ua fa'atasia: tatala ma tapuni i lona polokalame su'esu'e.
sync-write-back: Toe tusi suiga i GitLab: ulutala, fa'amatalaga, manatu, tapunia ma toe tatalaina
sync-write-back-error: Na le manuia le toe tusi i GitLab
email-bounces-description: O le mea e fai e WeKan i imeli e toe foʻi mai: o se tuatusi na sese le taina, o se pusa meli ua tumu, o se tali e le o iai i le ofisa, o se faitioga o le spam. O ituaiga taitasi e iai a latou lava gaioiga, e faia pe a toe foʻi mai i na taimi.
email-bounces-enabled: Puleaina imeli toe foʻi mai i le WeKan
email-bounces-threshold: Pe a uma ni taimi se fia
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Taofi le lafoina o imeli i le tuatusi
email-bounces-action-notify-inviter: Taʻu atu i lē na valaʻaulia
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: E le o iai le tuatusi: o se mea sese i le taina, o se teugatupe ua tapeina, o se domain e le iloa.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: E leʻi ausia mo le taimi nei: ua tumu le pusa meli, ua pisi le server. Na o le tele soso o loʻo iai se uiga.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Tali o le le i ai i le ofisa, malologa poʻo le faiga o tiketi. Na ausia le imeli.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Na faailoga e le na mauaina le imeli o se spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: I le Amazon SES, lafo atu faasilasilaga Bounce ma Complaint, ma se tulafono o le mauaina mo le tuatusi e lafo mai ai le WeKan, i se autu SNS, ma lesitala lenei tuatusi i ai e ala i le HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN o autu SNS e talia, tasi i le laina
email-bounces-stopped-only: Na o tuatusi e le toe lafoina i ai imeli e le WeKan
email-bounces-clear-hint: Faagalo le toe foʻi mai o lenei tuatusi ma toe lafo i ai imeli
email-bounce-invalid-topic: E le o se ARN o se autu SNS lena.
email-bounces-providers-description: Afai e lafo e WeKan e ala i se tasi o nei auaunaga, ki ai, tuu atu i le auaunaga lenei tuatusi webhook mo ana mea e tutupu o imeli na toe foʻi mai ma faitioga o le spam, ma faapipii iinei le ki e sainia ai, po o le upu faataga na e tuuina i le tuatusi e pei o https://user:password@… po o ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: O se auaunaga ua ki e manaʻomia lana ki saini po o le upu faataga.
activity-pub-enabled: O laupapa faitele e lolomi ai a latou gaoioiga o pepa i le fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: E tapuni i le amataga. A ki, e mafai ona mulimuli i laupapa faitele taitasi mai Mastodon ma isi 'auʻaunaga fediverse e pei o @board-<id> i le tuatusi o lenei WeKan, ma o gaoioiga fou o pepa e oo atu i e mulimuli ai. E faitau na o le pau: e leai se mea e auina mai e se ʻauʻaunaga fediverse e suia ai se laupapa, ma e le lolomiina lava laupapa tumaoti.
caldav-sync-desc: Tuu aso e tatau ai o pepa o lenei laupapa i se kalena - Nextcloud Calendar po o soo se kalena CalDAV. O se aso e tatau ai ua siitia i le kalena e toe foi mai i le pepa. Faaaoga se upu faataga o le polokalama, ae le o lau lava upu faataga.
caldav-enabled: Faatasi aso e tatau ai ma lenei kalena
caldav-invalid-url: O le tuatusi o le kalena e tatau ona avea ma tuatusi http:// po o https://, e aunoa ma se igoa o le tagata faaaoga po o se upu faataga i totonu.
caldav-not-linked: Sefe muamua se tuatusi o le kalena ma ki le faatasiga.
webdav-storage-description: Teu faapipiiga i se faila i luga o se ʻauʻaunaga WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud po o soo se isi. Faaaoga se upu faataga o le polokalama na faia mo WeKan. E mafai ona faaaoga iinei se ʻauʻaunaga i luga o le fesootaiga a WeKan lava ia, aua e na o le pule o le saite e seti lenei tuatusi.
sqrl-enabled: Saini i totonu i le SQRL
sqrl-desc: Tapē e masani ai. A ki, e ofoina e le itulau saini i totonu le SQRL, ma e muamua ona faaopoopo e sui lo latou faasinomaga SQRL i Faatulagaga a le Sui. E manaomia e le SQRL le WeKan i se tuatusi https://.
sqrl-sign-in: Saini i totonu i le SQRL
sqrl-scan: Su'esu'e le koti i lau polokalame SQRL, pe tatala lau kalani SQRL i lenei masini.
sqrl-expired: Ua uma le taimi o lenei koti SQRL. Toe amata.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: Ua lē manuia le saini i totonu i le SQRL.
sqrl-needs-https: E manaomia e le SQRL le WeKan i se tuatusi https://.
sqrl-description: Saini i totonu i lou faasinomaga SQRL nai lo se upu faataga. Faaopoopo iinei faatasi i lau kalani SQRL; e mafai ona e aveese iinei i soo se taimi.
sqrl-none: E leai se faasinomaga SQRL ua faaopoopo.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Ua tapē le saini i totonu i le SQRL mo lenei teugatupe mai lau kalani SQRL. Toe ki iina i lau koti laveai.
sqrl-only-on: Ua loka e lau kalani SQRL lenei teugatupe i le SQRL na o ia: ua teena isi auala uma e saini ai i totonu.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Ua loka mausali e lau kalani SQRL lenei teugatupe: ua teena le toe setiina o le upu faataga ma le suiina o le imeli.
sqrl-only: O lenei teugatupe e saini i totonu i le SQRL na o ia.
sqrl-hardlock: Ua loka lenei teugatupe i le SQRL: e le mafai ona toe maua pe suia i se isi lava auala.
windows-sso-sign-in: Saini i totonu i le Windows
windows-sso-failed: Ua lē manuia le saini i totonu i le Windows. Atonu e lē faatagaina lau tala Windows iinei.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: Leai ni poloka e tutusa na maua
enrollment-password-instructions: Fa‘amaonia lau upu fa‘ataga e amata ai le fa‘atulagaga. E lē fa‘aulufaleina oe i lau teugatupe i lenei la‘asaga. E lē mafai ona suia i inei se auala fa‘amaonia o loo fa‘aaogā.
enrollment-setup-denied: E lē mafai ona amata le fa‘atulagaga. Siaki au fa‘amatalaga e ulufale ai ma pe ua uma ona ki numera fa‘alilolilo e fa‘aaogā na o le tasi le taimi.
enrollment-code-instructions: Fa‘aaogā numera fa‘alilolilo e fa‘avae i le taimi: SHA1, ono fuainumera ma le va e 30 sekone. Aua ne‘i tufatufa le ki fa‘alilolilo. E muta lenei fa‘atulagaga pe a mavae le lima minute.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Ua uma ona fa‘aaogā le numera fa‘amaonia. A o le‘i ulufale, fa‘atali se‘ia fa‘aali mai e le polokalame fa‘amaonia se numera fa‘alilolilo fou.
registration-first-admin: O le teugatupe muamua i lenei vaega o le a maua ai fa‘atagaga a le pule aoao.
auth-too-many-attempts: Ua tele naua taumafaiga e ulufale. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
enrollment-setup-failed: Sa lē mafai ona amata le fa‘atulagaga.
registration-global-admin-disabled: E faia teugatupe a pule aoao i totonu lava o le faiga. Ua tapunia le lesitalaina mo tagata lautele.
auth-session-create-failed: Sa lē mafai ona amata le sauniga e ulufale ai.
registration-password-unavailable: E lē mafai ona lesitala i se upu fa‘ataga.
expedite-limit: E na o le tasi le pepa tatala o se laupapa e mafai ona Faanatinati i le taimi e tasi.
list-policy-placeholder: O afea e mafai ai e se pepa ona sau i lenei lisi, ma o afea e maea ai iinei?
commitment-point-hint: Mai lenei lisi e tautino ai le galuega; o lisi i ona luma o filifiliga.
person-wip-over: O __user__ e __count__ pepa tatala; o le tapulaa WIP i le tagata e __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: O le tulafono o lisi taitasi - o afea e mafai ai ona ulu mai se pepa ma o afea e maea ai iina - i le ulutala o le lisi. E ki i laupapa taitasi i Faatulagaga o le laupapa / Lisi.
feature-commitment-point-desc: O le lisi e tautino mai ai le galuega, ua faailogaina i lona ulutala. E filifilia i laupapa taitasi i Faatulagaga o le laupapa / Lisi.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: E fia pepa tatala e mafai e se tagata e toatasi ona taofi i se laupapa; e lapataia e se pepa tatala soo se tasi ua sili atu. E seti i laupapa taitasi i Faatulagaga o le laupapa / Lisi.
feature-standup-timer: Uati o le fonotaga o aso taitasi
feature-standup-timer-desc: Le fonotaga o aso taitasi i le lisi o le laupapa: sui o le laupapa i se faasologa fefiloi, e tutusa le taimi mo i latou taitoatasi. E tape mo laupapa taitasi i ona Faatulagaga o le Scrum.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Le laupapa o toe mafaufauga i le lisi o le laupapa: se laupapa fou faalilolilo ma lisi Amata ona fai, Taofi ona fai, Faʻaauau ona fai ma Mea e fai. E tape mo laupapa taitasi i ona Faatulagaga o le Scrum.
show-split-lists: Faʻataga lisi e vaevae i le O loo faia ma le Ua maea
list-split: Vaevae i le O loo faia ma le Ua maea
split-done: Ua maea iinei, o loo faatali e toso i luma
feature-split-lists-desc: O se lisi ua vaevaeina i le O loo faia ma le Ua maea: o le pepa ua faailogaina ua maea ai iina e faatali, ua pogisa, ina ia toso i le isi lisi, ma o le ulutala o le lisi e faitau uma mea e lua. E faatagaina mo laupapa taitasi i le Faatulagaga o le laupapa / Lisi, ona ki lea i le lisi autū o lisi taitasi.
workload-title: Uta o galuega ma le gafatia
workload-intro: O itula ua fuafuaina ma togi o tala o pepa ua tofia i tagata taitasi, vaiaso ma vaiaso, faatusatusa i itula o loo ia te i latou: o latou taimi faigaluega, toesea ma aso malolo lautele. Kiliki se vaiaso e vaai ai i ona pepa.
workload-truncated: Ua tele naua e faaali i le taimi e tasi: e na o tagata ma pepa muamua e faaali mai e le lipoti. Filifili ni vaiaso itiiti pe ni laupapa itiiti.
workload-legend-under: I lalo ifo o le afa o le gafatia
workload-legend-over: Sili atu i le 100 % o le gafatia
workload-unassigned: E le o tofia i se tasi
workload-no-cards: Leai ni pepa i lenei vaiaso.
workload-allocations-intro: O le a le tele o le taimi o se tagata e alu i se laupapa, po o a ni matafaioi e manaomia e se laupapa a o lei faaigoaina se tasi.
workload-role-placeholder: Leai se tasi: o se matafaioi
workload-invalid-estimate: O le fuafuaga e tatau ona i le va o le 0 ma le 10000 itula.
feature-workload-desc: Uta o galuega ma le gafatia i le lisi a le tagata faaaoga: itula ua fuafuaina ma togi o tala o pepa a tagata taitasi, vaiaso ma vaiaso, faatusatusa i o latou taimi faigaluega, toesea ma aso malolo lautele, faatasi ai ma tofiga i laupapa ma matafaioi le tumau.
billing-intro: O laupapa o oe o le pule: lo latou paketi, le tau o la latou galuega ua uma ma o le a avea i le totogi o le itula e te setiina, ma pili o itula ua faaaogaina. Na o pule o le laupapa e vaai i lenei mea.
billing-no-boards: E le o oe o se pule o se laupapa.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h e leai se totogi o le itula ma e le o faatauina. Seti se totogi mo le laupapa po o na tagata.
billing-default-rate: Isi tagata uma (faaletonu o le laupapa)
billing-nothing-to-invoice: Ua uma ona faapilia itula uma e mafai ona faapili.
billing-set-rate-first: Seti muamua se totogi o le itula mo lenei laupapa.
billing-no-invoices: E leai ni pili i le taimi nei.
billing-back-to-draft: Toe foi i le ata faataitai
feature-billing-desc: Paketi ma le pili i le lisi a le tagata faaaoga: le paketi o se laupapa i tupe po o itula, totogi o itula, le tau ma le valoaga o lana galuega, ma pili o itula e mafai ona faapili ua faaaogaina. Na o pule o le laupapa e vaai i ai.
billing-include-undated: Faaaofia le taimi na faamaumau ae lei teuina aso
billing-method-link: Sootaga totogi (kata, atotupe, totogi i luga o le initaneti)
billing-pay-by-scanning: Totogi e ala i le sikeni i lau polokalame faletupe po o totogi
billing-reverse-charge: Totogi faafeagai: o le tagata faatau e totogia le VAT
billing-undated-included: E aofia ai itula e __hours__ na faamaumau ae lei teuina aso.
billing-method-mnb: Koti QR fesiitaiga vave a Hanikeri
billing-field-promptpay-target: Numera telefoni, ID o le atunuu po o le ID atotupe faaeletonika
billing-field-proxy: Numera telefoni, UEN, ID FPS po o le imeli
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h e leai se tau o le itula ma e le o i totonu o le tau.
billing-bill-time: Faapili le taimi i le itula (tape: o se tau tumau, na o totogi ma tupe faaalu e faapilaina)
billing-approve-time: Faamaonia le taimi ae lei faapilaina
billing-default-customer: Le tagata faatau o le laupapa
billing-quote-valid-days: O tau ofo e aoga mo aso
billing-no-expenses: E leai ni tupe faaalu i le taimi nei.
billing-fees-intro: O se laasaga po o se tau tumau e faapilaina faatasi, mai lona aso; o se totogi faalemasina i masina uma mai lona aso seia oo i lona iuga.
billing-nothing-to-approve: E leai se taimi o loo faatali mo le faamaoniga.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h o loo faatali mo le faamaoniga ma e le o i luga o lenei pili.
billing-quotes-intro: O se tau ofo e tuu se tau i le galuega o totoe - le fuafuaga o kata tatala taitasi toese le taimi ua faaalu - ma totogi e lei faapilaina.
billing-accept-sets-budget: O se tau ofo ua talia e avea ma paketi o le laupapa
billing-no-quotes: E leai ni tau ofo i le taimi nei.
workload-utilization-title: Itula e mafai ona faapili ua tusia faatusatusa i le taimi faigaluega o nei vaiaso
workload-no-candidates: E leai se tasi e iai lenei tomai
cloud-panel-settings-intro: I le Tomeni o le Cloud Panel, e tausia e le SuperAdmin tomeni a tagata faatau, a latou faamaumauga, le DNS o le CloudFlare ma auala o le Caddy, ma e vaai tagata faatau taitoatasi i a latou pili ma talanoa ma le SuperAdmin. O le SuperAdmin o se pule o le WeKan o loo i ai nei.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Le tuatusi e faasino i ai tomeni (o se tuatusi IP po o se igoa o le host)
cloud-panel-cloudflare-proxied: E ui atu i le CloudFlare
cloud-panel-dns-conflict: Ua i ai muamua i le __name__ se faamaumauga __type__: ua tuu pea e pei ona i ai.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: E auina atu e le Caddy le Tomeni o le Cloud Panel ma tomeni faasoa uma i lenei WeKan, ma tomeni uma e i ai a latou lava faamaumauga i a latou lava atigi WeKan.
cloud-panel-caddy-admin: Tuatusi o le API pulega a le Caddy
cloud-panel-caddy-upstream: Lenei WeKan, e pei ona oo atu i ai le Caddy (host:port)
cloud-panel-caddy-pushed: Ua i ai i le Caddy auala fou.
cloud-panel-database-uri: Manoa fesootaiga (po o vaega o i lalo)
cloud-panel-customers: Tagata faatau e saini mai iinei (igoa faaaogā po o tuatusi imeli)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Teu lona faamaumauga DNS i le CloudFlare
cloud-panel-test-ok: Ua fesootai: tagata faaaogā __users__, laupapa __boards__, kata __cards__.
cloud-panel-import-users: Teugatupe: __created__ fou, __matched__ ua i ai iinei.
cloud-panel-import-files: Faapipii __count__: kopi foi faila mai le teuga faila o le WeKan tuai.
cloud-panel-chat-empty: E leai ni feau i le taimi nei.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: O le Cloud Admin e na o i le tuatusi o loo taʻua e le CLOUD environment variable a le sevā, mo ona pulega Cloud ma tagata faatau o domain o loo lisiina e ia.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Tuatusi IPv4 ma IPv6, ma vaega o tuatusi e pei o le 203.0.113.0/24, e mafai ai e le pule Cloud ona saini i totonu. Tasi i laina taʻitasi. Gaogao: so o se tuatusi.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: E leai lou tuatusi __address__ i lenei lisi. O le faasaoina e tapunia ai oe i fafo, o lea e le o faasaoina.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: O tuatusi IPv4 ma IPv6 ma vaega o tuatusi, tasi i laina taitasi, e mafai ona faʻaaogā ai le Laulau a le pule ma le admin REST API. Avanoa: soʻo se tuatusi.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: O le environment variable a le server ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES e filifilia, ae lē o lenei lisi.
admin-panel-address-refused: E lē mafai ona faʻaaogā le Laulau a le pule mai lou tuatusi __address__.
website-view-empty: E leʻi iai se mea ua lomia i lenei upega tafaʻilagi.
feature-views-website-desc: O le laupapa o se upega tafaʻilagi: o pepa o lona lisi Published, le ala Pages o le lisi autū ma isi pepa o ni tusitusiga, o mea fou muamua, faatasi ma a latou faapipiiga. E mafai ona tatala se laupapa lautele i lenei vaaiga, ina ia vaai tagata asiasi i le upega tafaʻilagi i le tuatusi o le laupapa.
feature-views-shop-desc: O oloa i pepa o se laupapa e pei o se faleoloa i luga o le upega: o se pepa e iai lona tau o se oloa, o ona igoa faailoga o vaega ia, ma o se oka o se pepa i le lisi o Oka. E mafai ona tatala se laupapa lautele i lenei vaaiga, ina ia faatau ai tagata asiasi i le tuatusi o le laupapa.
shop-decrement-stock: Toese oloa ua oka mai le oloa o loo totoe
shop-prices-include-vat: E aofia ai le Lafoga VAT i tau
shop-sale-lists: Lisi o loo faatau atu (leai se mea ua filifilia: o lisi uma vagana le lisi o Oka)
shop-category-labels: Igoa faailoga e faaali o ni vaega (leai se mea ua filifilia: o igoa faailoga uma)
shop-orders-private: E tusi oka i se laupapa faalilolilo, ona o se laupapa lautele e faaali uma pepa i tagata uma.
shop-guest-checkout: E mafai e tagata asiasi e leai se teugatupe ona oka
shop-show-on-public: Faaali le Faleoloa nai lo le laupapa lautele
shop-show-on-public-note: E tatala se laupapa lautele i le na o le tasi le vaaiga. O le filifilia o le Faleoloa iinei e suia ai __view__ mo tagata asiasi, ae o le filifilia o le Upega tafaʻilagi po o se isi vaaiga i Faatulagaga o le laupapa / Vaaiga o le Laupapa e suia ai le Faleoloa.
shop-cart-empty: E leai se mea i lau ato faatau.
shop-empty: E leai ni oloa i le taimi nei. O se pepa e iai lona tau i se lisi o loo faatau atu o se oloa.
shop-accept-terms: Ou te talia aiaiga ma tuutuuga
shop-privacy-note: E tusi lou igoa ma faamatalaga e faafesootai ai oe i le oka ina ia momoli e le faleoloa, ae le o se isi mea.
shop-price-changed: Ua suia se tau. Siaki le aofaiga fou ma toe oka.
shop-confirmation-email: Auina i le tagata faatau se faamaoniga o le oka i le imeli
import-board-instruction-wordpress: I le WordPress, filifili 'Tools', 'Export', 'All content' ma 'Download Export File', ma filifili lena faila .xml iinei, pe faapipii lona tusitusiga. O Squarespace, Wix ma isi upega e auina atu se faila WordPress e galulue faapena foi. O itulau uma ma tusitusiga uma e avea ma pepa i le lisi o lona tulaga, o itulau i le ala Pages ma tusitusiga i le Posts, faatasi ma ona anotusi, vaega ma tags o ni igoa faailoga, ma ana faamatalaga ua faamaonia.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Teu tusitusiga ma itulau o le WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts ma /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) o se faila .json e tasi, ma filifili iinei pe faapipii. O itulau uma ma tusitusiga uma e avea ma pepa i le lisi o lona tulaga.
import-board-instruction-ghost: I le Ghost, filifili 'Settings', 'Labs', 'Export your content', ma filifili le faila .json iinei pe faapipii. O itulau uma ma tusitusiga uma e avea ma pepa i le lisi o lona tulaga, faatasi ma ona tags o ni igoa faailoga.

help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: O le Vaaiga talanoaga e faaali ai le laupapa o se nofoaga talanoaga: o pepa taitasi e iai se talanoaga o se alalaupapa ma o ona faamatalaga o feau. O le laau o alalaupapa e aofia ai laupapa uma e te vaai i ai, ma le aofai o feau e te lei faitauina.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Tatala se nofoaga galuega ma se laupapa i Alalaupapa ma kiliki se pepa; e tatala i le vaega ogatotonu ma ona feau i le vaega talanoaga. Tusi se feau ma oomi le Enter pe kiliki Auina atu; o le Shift+Enter e amata ai se laina fou. Ina ia amata se talanoaga i se pepa e leai ni feau, kiliki Faʻaali pepa uma mo lena laupapa ma filifili le pepa. E faafeagai vaega mo gagana e tusi mai le taumatau i le agavale.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: O le Vaaiga o le puleaina o lomiga e faaali ai le laupapa o se mea e mataitu ai faafitauli o se faleteu o polokalame: o pepa o faafitauli, o igoa faailoga o igoa faailoga, o igoa faailoga e iai se aso e tatau ai o ni maailoga, o faamatalaga o le talanoaga ma o faapipiiga o faila. E aumai foi ma faatutusa faafitauli mai GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ma Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Vaavaai i faafitauli tatala ma tapunia, faamama e ala i se igoa faailoga po o se maailoga, ma tatala se faafitauli e faitau ma faaopoopo i lana talanoaga. E faitaulia se pepa ua tapunia pe a teuina pe iai i se lisi e pei o Tapunia po o Ua maea. O faafitauli fou e avea ma pepa i le lisi tatala o le laupapa, ma o le Tapuni po o le Toe tatala e siitia ai le pepa i le va o lisi tatala ma tapunia. O mea uma o faamatalaga masani o pepa, o lea e teuina ai suiga i le talafaasolopito o le laupapa.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: O Seti o koluma e mafai ai ona e faatulaga pepa lava ia i ni isi auala, e pei o le faamuamua, maailoga po o le tele, e aunoa ma le siitia o se pepa mai lona lisi. E iai i seti taitasi ona lava koluma lanu.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: E tusi e se pule o le laupapa se igoa i le Seti koluma fou ma kiliki Faaopoopo, ona faaopoopo lea o koluma ma se igoa ma se lanu. Filifili se seti i luga; o pepa uma o loo i se tasi o ona koluma po o le Le'i tuuina. Toso se pepa i se isi koluma e sui ai lona nofoaga i lenei seti na o ia; e tumau lona lisi, ala, igoa faailoga ma sui. E faaali foi e pepa taitasi ni igoa faailoga laiti mo lona koluma i isi seti.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: O le Vaaiga upega tafaʻilagi e faaali ai le laupapa o se upega tafaʻilagi na fau mai ana lava pepa ma faapipiiga, mo se faataitaiga se upega na aumai mai WordPress, Ghost, Blogger po o se upega tumau. E mafai ona tatala se laupapa lautele i lenei vaaiga, ina ia vaai tagata asiasi i le upega i le tuatusi o le laupapa.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: O pepa i se lisi e igoa Published o loo i luga o le upega, po o pepa o lisi uma pe a leai se lisi faapena; e le aliali lava pepa ua teuina. O pepa i se ala e igoa Pages e fai ai le lisi filifiliga, ma galuega laiti o ni itulau laiti, ma o isi pepa o ni tusitusiga i le itulau muamua, o le mea fou e muamua. O le faamatalaga auiliili o se pepa o le tusitusiga o le itulau ma o ona faapipiiga o ona ata ma faila. Ina ia faaaoga o le vaaiga o se laupapa lautele, filifili i Faatulagaga o le laupapa / Vaaiga o le Laupapa.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: O le Vaaiga o le Faleoloa e faaali ai oloa i pepa o le laupapa o se faleoloa i luga o le upega, ma ata, tau, vaega, se itulau o le oloa, se ato faatau ma le totogi. O se pepa i se lisi o loo faatau atu e avea ma oloa pe a iai se numera i lona fanua tau, ma o ona igoa faailoga e avea ma vaega.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: E faatulaga e se pule o le laupapa le faleoloa i Faatulagaga o le laupapa / Faleoloa: o fanua o le tau, numera o le oloa ma le aofai o loo teu, se Lisi o oka tumaoti, le tupe, le Lafoga VAT, auala totogi, lisi o loo faatau atu ma igoa faailoga e faaali o ni vaega, ona siaki lea o le Ua tatala le faleoloa. E faamama e tagata faatau e ala i vaega, faaopoopo oloa i le ato ma totogi. O oka taitasi e avea ma pepa fou i le Lisi o oka, ma e maua e le tagata faatau se imeli faamaonia.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: O le Faamama e faaali ai na o pepa e fetaui ma mea e te filifilia, e pei o igoa faailoga, sui, tagata ua tofia, aso, tau o fanua patino, tusitusiga o pepa po o le umi o iai pepa i se lisi. E le suia ai se pepa po o le avanoa o se tasi, ma e mafai ona sefe se tuufaatasiga o faamama i se igoa ma toe faaaoga.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Filifili igoa faailoga, tagata, aso po o isi tulaga i le itu, ma e faaali e le laupapa na o pepa e fetaui. I lalo o Igoa faailoga, o le OR e fetaui ma soo se igoa faailoga filifilia ma o le AND e manaomia uma; o le toe kilikiina o se igoa faailoga filifilia e le aofia ai. O le tusitusiga o le pepa e faaaoga a o e tusi. O le tapunia o le vaega e tumau ai le faamama seia e faamamaina. O le Saili Aoao, o iinei foi, e su'e ai pepa i ou laupapa uma.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: O le Saili e su'e ai pepa ma lisi o lenei laupapa o lo latou tusitusiga e iai le mea e te tusia, ma faaali pepa taitasi na maua i luga o le laupapa lava ia. I Laupapa uma, o le faamau lava lea e faaitiitia ai lau lisi o laupapa e tusa ai ma le ulutala.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Tusi i le fanua ma oomi le Enter. E lisi e le itu lisi ma pepa e fetaui, ma e tatala le pepa muamua i le laupapa ma se faitau i lalo o le fanua. Oomi toe le Enter mo le isi pepa po o le Shift+Enter mo le pepa muamua; e faapena foi aū ma toe amata mai. Kiliki se pepa po o se lisi i faaiuga e faaali ai i le laupapa, ma kiliki toe le Saili e tapuni ai le itu.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: O le Filifiliga e Tele e mafai ai ona e siaki ni pepa e tele ona fai lea o se mea e tasi ia i latou uma i le taimi e tasi: seti se igoa faailoga po o se sui, sui le lanu, sii, kopi pe teuina. I Laupapa uma e filifili ai laupapa nai lo pepa.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Faaola le Filifiliga e Tele i le ulutala o le laupapa, ona siaki lea o pusa siaki o pepa, pe faaaoga le Faamama i mea filifilia i le itu Faamama e filifili ai pepa uma o loo faaali e le faamama. Filifili se gaoioiga i le itu, e pei o le Seti le igoa faailoga mo mea filifilia, Sii mea filifilia po o le Sii mea filifilia i le Teuina. Kiliki Tape Filifiliga e Tele, le X i tafatafa o le faamau o le ulutala, pe a uma. E manaomia lou faatagaga e sui ai le laupapa.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: O Fanua patino o fanua faaopoopo lava a le laupapa mo pepa, e pei o se lomiga, se paketi, se tagata faatau, se pusa siaki po o se filifiliga mai se lisi. E faamatala faatasi le fanua mo le laupapa, ma e mafai e pepa taitasi ona taofi sona lava tau mo ia.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Kiliki + e fatu ai se fanua, tuu i ai se igoa ma se ituaiga (tusitusiga, numera, aso, lisi paʻū i lalo, lisi paʻū i lalo e tele filifiliga, pusa siaki, tupe po o se faataitaiga o tusitusiga) ma filifili le mea e faaali ai: i luga o le pepa, i le pepa laitiiti, i pepa fou po o pepa uma. E le mafai ona suia le ituaiga mulimuli ane. E mafai e fanua numera ma tupe ona faaali lo latou aofaiga i luga o lisi taitasi. Ona faatumu lea o tau o pepa i le pepa ua tatala.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: O le Teuina e taofi ai pepa, lisi ma ala na siitia i le Teuina. O le teuina e natia ai se mea e aunoa ma le leiloa, ina ia mafai ona toe faafoi mulimuli ane, ae o le soloia e aveese ai e faavavau.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Filifili le vaega Pepa, Lisi po o Ala ma kiliki Toe faafoi i tafatafa o se mea, po o le Toe faafoi uma. Atonu e le mafai ona toe faafoi se pepa a o teuina lona lisi pe tumu i lalo o lona tapulaa WIP, ma e taʻu mai e le Teuina. E vaai foi pule o le laupapa i le Soloi ma le Soloi uma, e le mafai ona toe faaleaoga. O laupapa ua teuina e toe faafoi mai le itulau Teuina o Laupapa uma.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: O le Tulaga muamua e faaali ai le mea na tuu ai ala, lisi ma pepa taitasi ina ua fatuina, ma po o fea o latou ua siitia talu mai lena. E aoga pe a uma se toe faatulagaga tele, pe vaai ai i le ulutala na fatu ai se pepa.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Faitau vaega e tolu, Ala, Lisi ma Pepa. E faaali e mea taitasi lona igoa o iai nei, Ua siitia pe a le o iai i le mea na tuu ai, le nofoaga na fatu ai, lona ulutala muamua pe a suia, ma le taimi na fai ai. Kiliki Faafou e toe faitau ai le talafaasolopito o le laupapa. O mea na fai a o lei faamaumauina tulaga e leai sona laina.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: O le Aotelega o se lipoti fonotaga o mea na tutupu i le laupapa, i tagata taitasi, e aumai mai faamaumauga lava a le laupapa. E taliina ai le mea na faia e i tatou taitasi i le aso mulimuli po o le vaiaso mulimuli, ma mea ua tuai.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Filifili Aso mulimuli po o Vaiaso mulimuli. O sui taitasi na faia se mea pe iai ni pepa ua tuai e maua ni vaega mo pepa Ua maea, Ua siitia, Ua faaopoopo ma Na faia se manatu, faatasi ai ma a latou pepa Ua tuai, ma e tatala pepa taitasi mai lona sootaga. Kiliki Kopi e pei o se tusitusiga e kopi ai le aotelega atoa, ua sauni e faapipii i se talanoaga po o se imeli.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: O le Talu mai lau asiasiga mulimuli e lisi ai mea na suia e isi tagata i lenei laupapa talu ona e tatalaina mulimuli: pepa fou, siitiaga, faamatalaga, suiga o aso e tatau ai ma sui na faaopoopo. E faaali e le mea i le lisi filifiliga le aofai o suiga.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: O le tatalaina o le laupapa e faamaumau ai lau asiasiga. Tatala lenei vaaiga e vaai ai i suiga faavasegaina i pepa, o le mea fou e muamua, ma kiliki se laina e tatala ai lena pepa. E le lisi ai au lava suiga. E mafai e se pule ona natia le tomai i Laulau a le pule / Faatulagaga / Tomai.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: O le Vaaiaina e filifili ai po o ai e mafai ona vaai i le laupapa: na o tagata ua faaopoopo i ai (Tumaoti), tagata faaaoga uma ua ulufale i lenei WeKan (Tagata faaaogā ua ulufale), po o soo se tasi e iai le sootaga (Lautele). O le teuteuina e tumau i sui o le laupapa sei vagana ua faataga e se pule o le laupapa.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: E kiliki e se pule o le laupapa le faamau vaaiaina i le ulutala o le laupapa ma filifili Tumaoti, Tagata faaaogā ua ulufale po o Lautele; o le filifiliga o iai nei e iai se faailoga siaki ma ona faaali lea e le faamau le faatulagaga fou. I se laupapa Tagata faaaogā ua ulufale po o Lautele, pe a faataga e le pule sili, e mafai foi e le pule ona siaki le E mafai e tagata uma ua ulufale ona teuteu. Mo isi tagata, e na o le faaali e le faamau le faatulagaga.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: O le Mataitu e seti ai le tele o mea e te faalogo ai e uiga i lenei laupapa: o le O loo Mataitu e faailoa atu ai suiga uma, o le Mataituina na o suiga i pepa na e fatuina pe o e sui ai, ma o le Faagū e leai se mea. O le faatulagaga e mo oe lava; e filifili e isi sui a latou.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Kiliki le faamau mataitu i le ulutala o le laupapa ma filifili O loo Mataitu, Mataituina po o Faagū; o lou tulaga o iai nei e iai se faailoga siaki ma e faaali e le faamau le tulaga fou. Afai e teena le suiga, e taʻu mai e se feau le mafuaaga ma e leai se mea e suia. E natia le faamau pe a tape e se pule sili le mataituina.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: O le Faavasega Pepa e suia ai le faasologa e faaali ai pepa i totonu o lisi taitasi: e tusa ai ma le aso e tatau ai, ulutala, taimi na fatu ai, palota po o le faasologa o igoa faailoga o le laupapa. E na o le mea e te vaai i ai e suia, ma e leai se pepa e siitia.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Kiliki Faavasega Pepa i le ulutala o le laupapa ma filifili se faasologa; e mulimuli i ai pepa i lisi taitasi ma e fai mai le faamau Ua ola le faavasegaga. Kiliki le X i ona tafatafa e aveese ai le faavasegaga ma toe foi i le faasologa na tosoina ai pepa. E teuina le filifiliga i lau su'esu'ega upega e oo lava pe a toe utaina. Mo le Faasologa o igoa faailoga, e mafai e se pule o le laupapa ona sui le faasologa i le Fa'aluagalua i luga ma le Fa'aluagalua i lalo pe a teuteu se igoa faailoga.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: O Faatulagaga o le laupapa e aoina ai mea uma e seti mo lenei laupapa e tasi: ona tulafono, fuafuaga, lanu ma le ata i tua, aso, vaaiga, ala, lisi ma pepa, auina atu ma aumai i totonu, faasilasilaga, webhooks ma le teuina. O le tele o mea e mo pule o le laupapa; o lau matafaioi ma faatulagaga o le upega e filifili ai mea e te vaai i ai.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Tatala le itu taumatau o le laupapa i le lisi filifiliga hamburger ma kiliki Faatulagaga o le laupapa. Filifili se mea ma e tatala lona lava faamalama po o lona itulau. Ua faavasegaina mea: o tulafono muamua, ona sosoo ai lea ma foliga o le laupapa, ona sosoo ai lea ma le auala e tusi ai, ona sosoo ai lea ma mea e o i totonu ma fafo, ma le mulimuli o le teuina.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: O le Sui le lanu e seti ai le autu lanu lava o lenei laupapa, lea e vaai i ai sui uma i lenei laupapa. O se auala e iloa vave ai le eseesega o laupapa. E na o pule o le laupapa e mafai ona suia.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Kiliki se faataitaiga o se autu; e faaaoga loa, e leai se faamau Sefe. Mo autu mafolafola ma manino, e mafai foi ona e filifili au lava lanu i uili lanu ma siaki i le vaaiga muamua. O se lanu e te setia mo oe lava i Faatulagaga o le sui e faamuamua pea nai lo le lanu o le laupapa mo oe.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: O se faasilasilaga o le laupapa o se feau e tusi e se pule o le laupapa mo tagata uma i lenei laupapa, e faaali i se pa i luga o lisi o le laupapa. Faaaoga mo ni faamatalaga e tatau ona vaai i ai sui uma, e pei o se aso faaiu po o se suiga i le auala e faaaoga ai le laupapa.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Tusi le tusitusiga, e oo atu i le 2000 mataitusi o tusitusiga masani, siaki le Faaali i tagata uma i lenei laupapa, ma kiliki Sefe. E vaai sui i le pa seia latou tapunia i lona X, lea e natia ai na o mo i latou. A teuteuina le faasilasilaga, e toe faaali atu i tagata uma.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: O se ata i tua o se ata e faaali i tua o lisi o le laupapa, ma o le ata foi o le laupapa i le itulau Laupapa uma. E mafai ona avea ma tuatusi o se ata i luga o le upega po o se ata ua tuu i luga ma teuina i WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Tusi se tuatusi o se ata i le URL o le Ata i Tua ma kiliki Sefe, pe faaaoga Aveese le Ata i Tua e aveese ai. Ina ia teu se ata, kiliki Tuuluga ata o le talaaga ma filifili se faila; o ata ua tuu i luga o loo lisi i lalo, lea o le kilikiina o se tasi e avea ai ma ata i tua o le laupapa, ma o faailoga e sii mai ai pe soloi ai.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: O le Aso e mafai ai e se pule o le laupapa ona filifili se faatulagaga o le aso e tasi mo tagata uma i lenei laupapa, nai lo le faatulagaga ua seti mo le upega atoa. O le faamalama lava lea e iai lau lava ki o numera o vaiaso ma, mo pule o le laupapa, le faatutusaina o le kalena e tuu ai aso e tatau ai pepa i se kalena CalDAV e pei o Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Siaki le Faatulagaga o le Aso o le laupapa, filifili se faatulagaga ma kiliki Sefe; aveese le siaki e toe mulimuli ai i le faatulagaga o le upega. O le faatulagaga lava a se sui ua faaola i Faatulagaga o le sui e manumalo pea. O le Faaali le vaiaso o le tausaga e faaola pe tape loa ai numera o vaiaso mo oe. Mo le faatutusaina o le kalena, tusi le tuatusi o le kalena, igoa o le tagata faaaoga ma se upu faataga o le polokalame, siaki le pusa faatutusa ma Sefe.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: O Faatulagaga o Laupapa Uma e filifili ai le mea e faaali e le ata o lenei laupapa i le itulau Laupapa uma, e pei o le aofai o pepa o lisi taitasi ma ata sui o sui. E seti ai foi le matutua o pepa, teuina otometi o pepa e le o pāina, ma pe o le lautele o lisi e patino pe faasoa.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Siaki pe aveese le siaki o se laina ma e sefe loa. A ola le matutua o pepa, tusi ni numera e tolu o aso e mou malie ai pepa i ni laasaga. Mo le teuina otometi, tusi le aofai o aso e aunoa ma se gaoioiga e mafai ona nofo ai se pepa a o lei teuina, pe tuu gaogao e tape ai. E le teuina lava Faataitaiga.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: O le Vaaiga o le Laupapa e filifili ai po o fea vaaiga, e pei o Ala, Lisi, Laulau, Kalena, Gantt po o ata, e ofo atu i le lisi filifiliga Vaaiga o le Laupapa o lenei laupapa, ma po o fea e tatala ai le laupapa. E seti eseese mo le taimi e lautele ai le laupapa ma le taimi e tumaoti ai.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: E tasi le laina o le faamalama mo vaaiga taitasi ma pusa siaki e fa: le vaaiga faaletonu ma vaaiga e faaali mo se laupapa lautele, ma ia mea e lua mo se laupapa tumaoti. Siaki le pusa Faaali o se vaaiga e ofo atu ai i le lisi filifiliga ma lona pusa Faaletonu e tatala ai le laupapa i ai.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: O le Ala e taofi ai faatulagaga o ala mo le laupapa atoa: pe mafai ona toso ala, pe mafai ona sui lo latou maualuga, pe faasoa e ala uma se laina e tasi o ulutala o lisi, ma po o fea fanua Scrum e faaali e se ala. O loo iinei foi le Tapulaa WIP (Lisi), o tapulaa o galuega o loo faia e faasoa i ni lisi e tele.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Siaki pusa e te manaomia; o le pusa siaki E mafai ona toso o loo i le laulau i luga. O le Se laina e tasi o ulutala o lisi e fa'asoa e faaali ai ala uma ma lisi uma o le laupapa i lalo o se laina ulutala e tasi e tumau i luga, e aunoa ma le suia o lisi. Kiliki le Tapulaa WIP (Lisi) i lalo e faaopoopo pe teuteu ai tapulaa faasoa.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: O le Lisi e taofi ai faatulagaga o lisi mo le laupapa atoa: pe mafai ona toso lisi, pe mafai ona sui lo latou lautele, pe tutusa le lautele o lisi uma, ma le fanua Scrum e faaali e se lisi. E faaola ai foi tulafono o le Tafega Kanban: tulafono o lisi, lisi ua vaevaeina i le O loo fai ma le Ua maea, se tulaga o le tautinoga ma se Tapulaa WIP i le tagata.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Siaki ki e te manaomia; o le pusa siaki E mafai ona toso o loo i le laulau i luga. A faatagaina le suiga o le lapoa, toso le au i le va o lisi e sui ai se lautele. E na o le aliali mai o se laina o se tulafono o le tafega pe a faaola lena tomai mo le upega, ma pe a ola, e seti ona auiliiliga mai le lisi filifiliga lava a lisi taitasi.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: O le Faleoloa e liua ai pepa o le laupapa i se faleoloa i luga o le upega e faaali i le vaaiga o le Faleoloa. help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: O Galuega Laiti e vaevae ai se pepa tele i ni pepa laiti e mafai ona tofia taitasi, fuafua taimi ma siitia na o latou, ae o le pepa matua e lisi ai ma faitau le aofai ua uma.
